method: OpenStreetMap way 1075274236 (amenity=research_institute, name='Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc', address text 'Galería de evacuación 12', Aía), taken verbatim. This is a separate, distinct OSM feature from way 711426145 (the surface administrative building at Canfranc-Estación, geometry:canfranc-surface-building), about 3.0 km away, and sits on the Somport/French-facing side of Monte Tobazo consistent with LSC's own description of the laboratory being reached via an evacuation gallery between the two Somport tunnels.
name: Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc (underground laboratory)
notes: This is the underground laboratory itself, not the surface administrative building in Canfranc-Estación that site:lsc-canfranc's existing coordinate (precision_m 500) actually reflects; see the facility worklog for a proposed site coordinate correction (and a proposed kind change to underground_lab).

summary.plain: The Canfranc underground laboratory itself, beneath Mount Tobazo between the historic railway tunnel and the modern Somport road tunnel, distinct from its surface offices in Canfranc-Estación.
